artifact_id_rule: artifact: + SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON {scope_id,dataset}, with sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=true and finite JSON values
provenance: Entirely synthetic tables, scope IDs, requests and agent-authored translations. Fixed literal results are declared before any candidate inference; no private source data or live service inventory was copied.
reference_construction: Independent authored integer totals: 10 + 15 + 35 = 60 EUR; 2 + 3 + 7 = 12 kg. Control artifact hashes identify data, not the answer. The executed tool runtime never reads reference assertions.
limitations: All four cases are training fixtures; there is no calibration/test benchmark.
Both families share the same lookup-to-sum operation pattern, also used in earlier training controls.
FR/EN variants share their table, scope, reference and content-addressed artifact ID.
The first lookup is fixed by the harness; only the next-call proposal is provided by the scripted candidate.
Argument values are constrained by the published schema; no real model output path is qualified.
Actual synthetic tool execution is separate from any live MCP or application integration.
References and translations remain agent-authored, not human-certified.
